Name: Seed Maker - Better quality more seeds
Author: Ejbo
Description:
[b]Seed Maker - Better quality more seeds

[/b]This mod will increase the amount of seeds you get from the Seed Maker depending on the quality of the crop or fruit used.
It does not alter what crops or fruit is allowed to become seeds.
It should work with Custom Crops out of the box, as long as they are in the StadrewValley.Category Crop or Fruit.

[b]Quality ﻿M[/b][b]in[/b][b] ﻿Max
[/b]Normal ﻿1      ﻿4
Silver     ﻿2     ﻿5
Gold      ﻿3      ﻿6
Iridium ﻿5     ﻿8

[b]Random chance for "Ancient Seed" or "Mixed Seeds"
[/b]This mod will not alter the chance or the amount you get when you randomly get an "Ancient Seed" or "Mixed Seed" from another crop/fruit.
But just as a note, Ancient Fruit will stil get the tweak applied since it was dropped in the Seed Maker.

[b]Compatabilites
[/b]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url], it will patch the Automate SeedMakerMachine if Automate is installed. (Not a required mod)
- Mod Config Menu (Not a required mod)
